The flag signal code

Still hoisted whenever the radio link to the mainland fails.

FlagMeaning
Greymail boat sighted
Bluepilot requested
Redharbour closed, do not enter
Whitedoctor needed on the island
Blackdeath in the settlement
Yellowfresh water short

Rules

  1. A flag is valid only while it is hoisted; lowering it is the cancellation.
  2. Two flags on one mast are read from the top down.
  3. Red over anything means the harbour is closed and the rest has to wait.
  4. White over black is forbidden.
  5. Half mast means "understood, help is on the way".

Invented material for testing.
